scenarios.detection: Deep health and queue/cache probes report Redis unavailable.
scenarios.recovery: Restore Redis, wait for health, and confirm queue processing resumes.
scenarios.dataSafety: No FLUSHALL, eviction-policy change, or volume deletion is allowed.
scenarios.externalRequirements: Native service-manager recovery must be recorded externally; no native command is run.

scenarios.detection: Operator snapshot reports a missing worker and queue backlog.
scenarios.recovery: Restart the worker and confirm its health check plus queue drain.
scenarios.dataSafety: Jobs are paused, not removed or retried destructively.
scenarios.externalRequirements: Native service-manager recovery must be recorded externally; no native command is run.

scenarios.detection: Operator snapshot reports the Reverb listener unavailable.
scenarios.recovery: Restart Reverb and confirm the TCP health check.
scenarios.dataSafety: The fault never modifies database, cache, or storage volumes.
scenarios.externalRequirements: Native service-manager recovery must be recorded externally; no native command is run.

scenarios.detection: Public health requests fail while the isolated Compose project remains inspectable.
scenarios.recovery: Unpause the Laravel gateway and rerun health.
scenarios.dataSafety: Uses Docker pause/unpause only; no host firewall or public network changes.
scenarios.externalRequirements: Native service-manager recovery must be recorded externally; no native command is run.

scenarios.detection: The runner confirms its bounded temporary pressure sentinel; a full-disk application alarm requires separate operator evidence.
scenarios.recovery: Remove only the runner-owned /tmp file and rerun health.
scenarios.dataSafety: Requires explicit disk opt-in; writes only a bounded temporary file in the isolated container.
scenarios.externalRequirements: Native service-manager recovery and a production full-disk alarm must be recorded externally; no native command is run.
